inspiration: Boss as a rotation of tells: abyssador.xml gives one boss five attack channels, each with its own interval and roll (fire, energy, lifedrain, earth, speed). It also re-targets on a timer roll (targetchange interval 5000, chance 8). Keep: several timed channels, each with its own roll. Change: our own wind-up and telegraph shapes and our own channel names.

A cheap timed slow as a readable tell: the 'speed' channel in abyssador.xml applies a speed change of -400 for duration 2500, chance 20. Keep: a timed slow that ends by itself. Change: a distinct ring, colour and sound so the status is readable at 375 px.

Self-protection: the boss has a healing defence with interval 1000 and chance 1, a healing defence with interval 5000 and chance 30, and an invisibility defence with interval 2000, chance 25, duration 3000 (units as written in the file, not converted). Keep: healing on a roll with a clear cue. Change: a telegraphed glow and a sound cue, not a silent heal.

Damage typing as data: the elements block gives percentages per damage type (physical +10, death -20, energy -20 in abyssador.xml). A creature can be weak or strong to one damage type with no code change. Fits the many-on-one and zone data rulings.

An item that comes alive: animated_sword.xml is a creature whose look is an item look (look typeex 26883), experience 0, speed 360, with melee and a short manadrain/energy mix. Keep: an enemy that looks like the thing it was. Change: silhouette, palette and attack names so it is clearly ours.

Spawn clusters as data: forgotten-spawn.xml has 362 spawn blocks, each a centre, a radius of 5 and a list of monsters with spawntime 60 s. This is a direct data model for row 23 (zone population: cap, respawn, coverage). Keep: centre, radius and respawn as plain fields. Change: our own cap and grace-timer values.

Gold-plated armour as a stat line: 'golden armor' in items.xml is weight 8000, armour 14, slot body. The gold look is a client sprite, not in this box. Idea for us: keep the armour number and make the gold a palette ramp and specular task for an artist, not a data field.

Cosmetic unlock table: outfits.xml lists each outfit by sex type with looktype, premium flag and unlocked flag. Idea for progression (cosmetic collections): one table with an unlocked yes or no and a premium flag per look.

briefs.label: Multi-channel tyrant boss (own label)
briefs.why: A boss that reads as a cycle of tells: five timed attacks and a rare self-heal, so the fight has rhythm.
briefs.keep: five timed attack channels with separate rolls; a re-target roll on a timer; a rare telegraphed self-heal
briefs.change: silhouette (tall, crowned, no island theme); palette (cold teal and bone instead of the donor's colours); attack names and wind-up shapes of our own
briefs.ref: data/monster/monsters/abyssador.xml (lines 22-50 for the attack channels, line 39 for the healing roll)

briefs.label: Sentient blade (own label)
briefs.why: An item that comes alive is instantly readable and cheap to author: the look is a weapon, the behaviour is a small fast melee with a bolt.
briefs.keep: the look is an item; experience 0 in the file (what that means in the server logic was not read); a fast melee tempo of about 2 s
briefs.change: silhouette (hooked polearm, not a straight blade); element colour ramp; attack set (no manadrain; a pull instead of a plain energy bolt)
briefs.ref: data/monster/monsters/animated_sword.xml (line 2 for race and name, line 4 for the item look, the flags block, not line-numbered)

briefs.label: Scatter pack spawn block (own label)
briefs.why: A spawn cluster with a radius and a respawn timer makes a patrol feel like a place, not a grid.
briefs.keep: a centre with a small radius; a per-member respawn of 60 s; members placed with small offsets
briefs.change: our own pack size and cap; a patrol path instead of a fixed spot; grace timer before despawn
briefs.ref: data/world/forgotten-spawn.xml (line 3 for the spawn centre and radius, line 4 for a member)
